text.text: Dedicated walking paths within the residential areas, allowing residents to move around safely on foot.

Each road gives more of its width to people. Among the homes, lanes are for walking only. Cycle and pedestrian lanes link homes to work and to the rest of the island, and buses and cycles share the roads at the edge, so traffic stays out of the centre.
Three types of road in plan and section, at one scale.
Dedicated routes for people who cycle or walk to work and around the island.
A road network along the perimeter and key edges of the residential zone, with dedicated bus lanes along high-traffic routes.
